items.q: Our class ______ shows that we have PE right after lunch on Mondays.
items.vi: Thời khóa biểu của lớp mình cho thấy thứ Hai có tiết Thể dục ngay sau giờ ăn trưa.
items.explanation: A timetable lists when each lesson happens. A register records who is present, a diary is personal, and an agenda is the list of points for a meeting.

items.q: Lan ______ most of her pocket money on comic books and film magazines.
items.vi: Lan tiêu phần lớn tiền tiêu vặt vào truyện tranh và tạp chí điện ảnh.
items.explanation: We spend money on something. Pay takes for, cost needs the thing as its subject, and use money on is not a natural collocation.

items.q: By next Friday, Lan ______ all her exam revision, so she can join the camping trip.
items.vi: Đến thứ Sáu tuần sau, Lan sẽ ôn thi xong hết nên có thể tham gia chuyến cắm trại.
items.explanation: By + a future time marks an action that will be complete before that point, so we use the future perfect: will have finished. Will finish only says it happens in the future, and the present forms cannot follow by next Friday.

items.q: The new coach is strict: any player who refuses to ______ will be dropped from the team.
items.vi: Huấn luyện viên mới rất nghiêm: cầu thủ nào không chịu tuân thủ kỷ luật sẽ bị loại khỏi đội.
items.explanation: Toe the line means to obey the rules. Cross the line is to go too far, draw the line is to set a limit, and hold the line is to keep a position.

items.q: The doctor told Nam to ______ sweets and fizzy drinks before the big race.
items.vi: Bác sĩ bảo Nam giảm bớt kẹo và nước ngọt có ga trước cuộc đua lớn.
items.explanation: Cut down on means to reduce the amount of something you eat or use. Cut off means to disconnect, cut up means to chop, and cut across means to take a short way through.

items.q: Lan got full ______ in the music quiz because she knew every song.
items.vi: Lan được điểm tối đa trong cuộc thi đố vui âm nhạc vì bạn ấy biết hết mọi bài hát.
items.explanation: Full marks is the fixed phrase for the highest possible score. Grades are letters like A or B, a degree is a university qualification, and levels are stages.

items.q: Nam ______ have bought the concert tickets yet — the box office doesn't open until ten.
items.vi: Nam không thể nào đã mua vé buổi hòa nhạc được — quầy vé mười giờ mới mở cửa mà.
items.explanation: Can't have + past participle says that something was impossible in the past. Needn't have and shouldn't have describe things that actually happened, and mustn't have is not used for deduction.

items.q: Nam ______ two goals in the final, so his team won the school cup.
items.vi: Nam ghi hai bàn trong trận chung kết nên đội của cậu ấy giành cúp của trường.
items.explanation: In football you score a goal. You win a match or a cup, not a goal, and make and hit do not collocate with goal.

items.q: Nam told his mother everything ______ had happened at the football match.
items.vi: Nam kể cho mẹ nghe mọi chuyện đã xảy ra ở trận bóng đá.
items.explanation: After everything, all and superlatives, the relative pronoun is that. What cannot follow a noun it refers back to, who is for people, and which is not used after everything.

items.q: Lan has to ______ two chapters of history tonight, so she can't come to the cinema.
items.vi: Tối nay Lan phải ôn lại hai chương lịch sử nên không đi xem phim được.
items.explanation: Revise means to study something again before a test. Rehearse is for practising a performance, remind needs a person as its object, and repeat means to say or do again.

items.q: There were very ______ people at the early screening, so we got the best seats.
items.vi: Có rất ít người ở suất chiếu sớm nên bọn mình được ngồi chỗ đẹp nhất.
items.explanation: People is countable, so we use few; little goes with uncountable nouns. Very cannot come before a few or a little.

items.q: Since Nam started spending every evening at the game arcade, he ______ in maths.
items.vi: Từ khi Nam bắt đầu tối nào cũng ở tiệm game, cậu ấy đã bị tụt lại môn toán.
items.explanation: Since + a past starting point describes a situation that began in the past and continues now, so the main clause takes the present perfect: has fallen behind.

items.q: Nam remembers ______ his wallet on the shop counter, but now it isn't there.
items.vi: Nam nhớ là đã để ví trên quầy cửa hàng, nhưng giờ nó không còn ở đó nữa.
items.explanation: Remember + -ing refers to a memory of something that happened. Remember + to-infinitive means not forgetting to do a future action.

items.q: I didn't want to go to the concert, but Lan ______ and I ended up buying a ticket.
items.vi: Tôi không muốn đi xem hòa nhạc, nhưng Lan cứ nài ép nên cuối cùng tôi cũng mua vé.
items.explanation: Twist someone's arm means to persuade someone to do something they don't want to do. Pull someone's leg is to joke, catch someone's eye is to attract attention, and hold someone's hand is to support them closely.

items.q: Set your alarm tonight; ______, you will miss the early bus to the museum.
items.vi: Tối nay nhớ đặt báo thức, nếu không bạn sẽ lỡ chuyến xe buýt sớm đi bảo tàng.
items.explanation: Otherwise means 'if you don't do that': no alarm, so you miss the bus. Therefore shows a result, besides adds a point, and although introduces a contrast clause, not a separate sentence.

items.q: The school ______ ends next week, so the swimming pool will be full of students.
items.vi: Học kỳ sắp kết thúc vào tuần tới nên bể bơi sẽ đầy học sinh.
items.explanation: A term is one of the parts a school year is divided into. A period or lesson lasts under an hour, and a break is the time between lessons.

items.q: The bookshop has ______ plastic bags, so remember to bring your own.
items.vi: Hiệu sách đã bỏ hẳn túi ni lông, nên nhớ mang túi của mình theo.
items.explanation: Do away with means to get rid of or stop using something. Do up means to fasten or repair, do without means to manage without, and do in means to exhaust.

items.q: If I ______ more pocket money, I would buy that second-hand guitar.
items.vi: Nếu tôi có nhiều tiền tiêu vặt hơn, tôi sẽ mua cây đàn ghi-ta cũ đó.
items.explanation: A second conditional (unreal present) takes the past simple in the if-clause and would + verb in the main clause: If I had… I would buy.

items.q: Lan ______ chess with her grandfather every Sunday afternoon.
items.vi: Chiều Chủ nhật nào Lan cũng chơi cờ vua với ông.
items.explanation: We play games like chess and football. Do goes with activities like yoga or homework, go with -ing sports like swimming, and make does not collocate with games.

items.q: Either Nam or his sister ______ going to buy the tickets this afternoon.
items.vi: Hoặc Nam hoặc chị của cậu ấy sẽ đi mua vé chiều nay.
items.explanation: With either… or, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, his sister, so it is singular: is.

items.q: The novel ______ by our English teacher turned out to be much funnier than I expected.
items.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết được cô giáo tiếng Anh giới thiệu hóa ra vui hơn tôi tưởng nhiều.
items.explanation: A past participle replaces a passive relative clause: the novel (which was) recommended by our teacher. The -ing form would mean the novel itself was recommending something.

items.q: Nam can't go to football practice tonight because he has too much ______ to finish.
items.vi: Tối nay Nam không đi tập bóng đá được vì có quá nhiều bài tập về nhà phải làm.
items.explanation: Homework is school work done at home. Classwork is done in class, housework is cleaning and cooking, and paperwork is office forms and documents.

items.q: Nam and Lan often lend ______ their favourite comic books.
items.vi: Nam và Lan thường cho nhau mượn những cuốn truyện tranh yêu thích.
items.explanation: Each other shows that Nam lends to Lan and Lan lends to Nam. Themselves would mean each lends to himself or herself, and ourselves / yourselves do not match the subject.

items.q: Let's watch the new animated film on Saturday, ______?
items.vi: Thứ Bảy mình đi xem bộ phim hoạt hình mới nhé?
items.explanation: A suggestion with Let's takes the tag shall we. Will you follows an imperative, and do / don't we follow present simple statements.

items.q: Nam ______ a comic book in bed when the lights suddenly went out.
items.vi: Nam đang đọc truyện tranh trên giường thì đèn bỗng nhiên tắt.
items.explanation: A longer action in progress (was reading) is interrupted by a short past action (the lights went out): past continuous + past simple.
